# github-repo-to-x-threads Documentation Map

Start here when an agent or LLM needs to understand this repository without
loading every file.

- `AGENTS.md` - repository operating rules, source-of-truth boundaries, safety,
  and verification gates.
- `INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md` - install, credential, operation, publish, and
  verification protocol for agents.
- `CLAUDE.md` - Claude Code entrypoint that points back to the canonical
  protocol.
- `skillpack.json` - bundle-level skillpack manifest.
- `openclaw.plugin.json` - OpenClaw/Hermes-style plugin manifest.
- `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` - Codex plugin adapter.
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` - Claude plugin adapter.
- `skills/_AGENT_README.md` - cold-start contract for the skills directory.
- `skills/RESOLVER.md` - routing table from user intent to skill.
- `skills/manifest.json` - machine-readable skill index.
- `skills/github-repo-to-x-threads/SKILL.md` - canonical workflow.
- `skills/github-repo-to-x-threads/references/` - detailed brand profile,
  bug-report rewrites, paper-to-system templates, model quality chain, gates,
  rubrics, posting pack templates, and self-evolution contracts.
- `skills/github-repo-to-x-threads/scripts/` - deterministic helpers for
  evidence collection, pack generation, eval, publishing, metrics, and
  strategy memory.
- `commands/github-repo-to-x-threads.md` - Claude slash-command adapter.
- `runbooks/bootstrap.md` - post-scaffold validation runbook.
- `evals/evals.json` - high-level behavior eval cases.
